analysis:
Changes are CI workflow files only: darkbloom-route.yml, darkbloom-watchdog.yml, desktop.yml. None touch the provider, the coordinator wire contract, attestation, keys, prefix cache, or the other threat-model assets and boundaries, so I found no regressions against them.

darkbloom-route.yml: adds a max-attempts input (default 6). It is validated with ^[1-9]$ before use, so there is no injection path into jq or curl. The inputs and vars still reach the shell only through env, not interpolated into the script. configuration_error now strips CR, LF and % and truncates to 200 chars, which hardens workflow-command injection through lane text. Retry-After is parsed strictly (single header, digits only, at most 5 digits, at most 86400) and capped at 15s. A 140s wall-clock ceiling stays under the 3-minute job timeout. The plane reply is still untrusted: runs_on must exactly equal the fixed profile labels, and all printed text goes through clean. The response_headers temp file is removed by the trap. The HTTPS-only (--proto '=https') and --max-filesize controls are unchanged. No new secrets are sent. The request still contains only the repository, run id and lanes.

darkbloom-watchdog.yml: the stranded condition is narrowed. A run is no longer cancelled if any Darkbloom job of the current attempt has a runner, is in progress, or succeeded. This is more conservative and reduces destructive cancels and fallback to paid runners. The jq expression keeps the original any(...) or any(...) structure. The permissions (actions: write, checks: write) are unchanged, and no new write surface is added.

desktop.yml: adds a concurrency group keyed by PR number or ref with cancel-in-progress: true. Cancellation is scoped per PR or ref, and the workflow runs with contents: read. It only cancels superseded runs. Fork PR runs are keyed by their own PR number, so cross-PR cancellation is not possible. The only downside is availability of superseded CI runs, which is intended.

No remaining integration questions that bear on security.
